title: The completed lift of the strict-system Chern adjunct
statement: Let l be prime and f:X→S a morphism of Noetherian schemes with DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Give a Presentation p over ULift(Q_l) [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation] and assume l invertible on S. Define systemChern as exact restriction of model.chernAdjoint followed by p.varying. There exists c:completedUnit(S)→p.Rc(completedLine(X)[2]) whose constant-scalar restriction followed by p.sourceMap equals p.coefficientsS.unitMap followed by p.LS.R(systemChern). This is a normalization of the Chern adjunct only; it asserts no trace equation.

source.place: paragraph (1), the strict-system section class, passage to Rlim, and completed coefficients

proof.text: The completed unit is derived complete. The Tate line is locally free of rank one because l is invertible on X, and is therefore complete; shifts preserve right orthogonality to l-invertible objects.

A right adjoint to an additive functor preserves right orthogonality to l-invertible objects. Apply the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction and the normalized completed comparison to deduce completeness of p.Rc(completedLine(X)[2]).

The full inclusion of complete objects followed by constant-scalar restriction is fully faithful. Apply its fullness in the direction from the completed unit to the completed pushforward. The desired underlying arrow is unitMap followed by Rlim(systemChern) followed by the inverse of sourceMap; sourceMap is invertible by line_limit.
Multiply the lifted equality by sourceMap and cancel its inverse. This is exactly the required normalization, without choosing any trace.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_completedChern_lift
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    ∃ c : completedUnit l S ⟶ p.Rc.R.obj ((completedLine l X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).map c ≫
          p.sourceMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) =
        p.coefficientsS.unitMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) p.LS ≫
          p.LS.R.map (p.systemChern l)
